Hi, all. Someone in FPH let me know this group was here. I think I really do need somewhere to go to talk about this stuff. Somewhere supportive so I can work on getting back to my happy weight without getting out of control.

Life has been bringing out old demons lately and it's really making me face how I look and what I weigh -- and that's something I avoid doing at all costs. I wear sweats every day to hide myself and I don't wear makeup because I don't like to look at myself long enough to apply it.

I'm 5'7" and currently 135 (maybe 137, around there) and I do work with a trainer on and off to keep my weight in check but I'm not really happy with myself over 127/130 lbs. I've blocked it out for so long and lately it's just been on my mind constantly. I wish I could quit my job and focus on exercising and sleeping (my anxiety is awful so I never sleep well so my workouts have become this half assed cardio routine that just feels pointless. I love working out but lately my heart isn't in it, just going through the motions)

I miss sleeping. I miss having the energy to work out for hours each day. I'm so tired ALL THE TIME now. Like falling over exhausted every minute of the day and I'm starting to fray at the edges.

I know I have it in me to get down to 127, even less. But part of me is afraid I don't have it in me to do it without getting out of control so I keep self sabotaging and staying at 135.

I want to be at my "happy weight" of 127 or less. I just need to stay calm and focused long enough to get back on track. But it's 2am and I'm up crying because I feel so fat, I have to work at 9am so I'm not sure how focused I'll be tomorrow.

Hi and thanks for introducing yourself! I have been so busy as of late so I'm sorry to read this two weeks after the fact.

The make-up thing is interesting because I wear it so people make fewer comments on my appearance. I live in South Korea and appearance is a big deal here. Adding the make-up allows me to put on a mask of sorts to cover up my face without using an actual mask. It helps me hide.

I was restricting a lot and getting tired, I know what that's like. I started eating more and...yep...gained weight. Now I'm trying to get back down to where I want to be while eating something sane. It'll take longer but hopefully will be more sustainable.

I know it's late but maybe when you can't sleep just do a bunch of sit ups to tire yourself out and a tea that will chill you out. Then think about things not in your life when you close your eyes. Like living in a castle or being Jon Snow. It helps sleep when you are stressed. <3
